cell_line.evidence: Normal human dermal fibroblasts (NHDF), kindly provided by Verena Paulitschke from the General Hospital of Vienna, were cultured in RPMI 1640 (Life Technologies, UK) supplemented with 10% FCS and 100U/ml penicillin/streptomycin (both ATCC, USA) at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Similar findings were obtained with human mesenchymal stem cells, and results were confirmed by targeted analysis with multiple reaction monitoring.
